name: Mahindra Blossom
tagline: Launching 2, 3 & 4 BHK homes in HopeFarm Jn, Whitefield
overview: A 7.8-acre development abutting Hopefarm Channasandra Metro Station in Whitefield, with 4 acres of expansive greens and 97,000 sq.ft. of amenities and clubhouse spaces. Homes are east-west facing across six wings (A–F) with 2, 3 and 4 BHK layouts, pre-certified IGBC Green Homes Gold Rating.
highlights: Key terminals within 1.3 km: Whitefield Railway Station, Hopefarm bus stop
Major IT parks within 2.5 km: ITPL, new Google office
7.8* acres of development with 4 acres of expansive greens
97,000 sq.ft. of amenities and clubhouse spaces
Half-Olympic size swimming pool, business centre, 2 badminton courts
High street retail within the development
East-west facing homes with large 90 sq.ft. balconies in 3, 3.5 and 4 BHK
Walk-in wardrobe in larger typologies, Vaastu compliant homes
Pre-certified IGBC Green Homes Gold Rating, Net Zero Waste
Over 80 years of Mahindra's heritage; Golden Peacock Award for Corporate Governance
amenities: High street retail within the development
Clubhouse spaces (97,000 sq.ft. total with amenities)

locationInfo.summary: 7.8* acres just steps from Hopefarm Channasandra metro and minutes from Bengaluru's IT corridor — ITPB, Whitefield Station and the Outer Ring Road are all within reach, with the upcoming Blue and Pink metro lines improving connectivity further.
